policy.runtime: policy/velstand_np.py (numpy port, max abs err 2.1e-6 vs onnxruntime 1.31.0 on 1,000 obs)

simulator.actuators: XML position actuators (kp 0.55, forcerange +-0.96 N*m), not Pollen's BAM M6 model
simulator.body_config_note: phys_delay 4 = 20 ms actuator lag, reading training's BAM delay_min/max_lag 3..6 as 5 ms physics steps (unit not stated in the vendored code); jv_lag 1 = training's 1-control-step joint_vel obs lag. Valid for this body only: the frozen command bounds do not reliably start a gait on the plain no-lag body.
simulator.head_camera: MJCF camera turned 180 deg about its right axis (as Pollen's sim/camera.py does), image rotated upright

vx_forward_mps.note: commands 0.1-0.15 do not reliably start a gait from standing; 0.2 starts from every standing state tried (review_checks.json)

vx_backward_mps.note: -0.2 moves the duck only once it is already walking (from_rest.json); not gate-tested, so not allowed

vy_mps.note: lateral commands barely move the body (0.3 -> 0.04-0.06 m/s)

wz_radps.allowed: turn in place: 0 or +-0.5..0.6; while walking forward (vx 0.2..0.4): any |wz| <= 0.6 (the gate's pad controller steers this way)
wz_radps.note: wz 0.3 does not start turning in place from standing (from_rest.json); +-0.5 and +-0.6 start from every standing state tried on this body (review_checks.json) but NOT on the plain no-lag body; turning overshoots

head_pose_rad.allowed: within 0.8 x caps (neck_pitch 1.1, head_pitch 1.1, head_yaw 1.4, head_roll 0.31)

for_M2: Skills must close the loop on position/heading (odometry): speeds are about half the command forward and about 1.4x on turns, and the gait snaps between standing and a minimum walking speed rather than creeping. Commanded straight, the duck curves left: median +0.22 rad/s over the 70 forward-only gate segments (found in M1), so heading must be servoed as well.
